2ACB201C3F8D64E6FB2FB1B4F3BF9D67.source: Mind the pot, dear. The pot minds nobody.
2ACB201C3F8D64E6FB2FB1B4F3BF9D67.target: 当心那口锅，孩子。那口锅可不会当心任何人。

3D8D3637DF0F2F1929436DE8A8F26B82.source: I grease the gears! Miller Hesk says I have a gift for it. A sticky gift.
3D8D3637DF0F2F1929436DE8A8F26B82.target: 我负责给齿轮上油！磨坊主赫斯克说我在这方面有天赋。黏糊糊的天赋。

3D0477C1F21667C535EA950AC4DD4E58.source: Open Doors — every house has a room behind its door
3D0477C1F21667C535EA950AC4DD4E58.target: 敞开的门——每座房子的门后都有一个房间

4ACC0102F0EE64357897DD20E946742A.source: Two pops. Clear skies, then. Probably.
4ACC0102F0EE64357897DD20E946742A.target: 响了两下。那就是晴天。大概吧。

4E71AE06AE8177C4E0D2B34FA22389CD.source: Listen — that creak is the wind turning the cap. It means the weather is changing. Or that I missed a gear.
4E71AE06AE8177C4E0D2B34FA22389CD.target: 听——那嘎吱声是风在转动风车顶。说明天气要变了。要不就是我漏了一个齿轮没上油。

5F832304830031CF72F17D667103B527.source: Mm? Oh. Wendel, tinker. Tobin lets me sleep up here when the inn is full, if I mend his pots.
5F832304830031CF72F17D667103B527.target: 嗯？哦。温德尔，补锅匠。旅店住满的时候，只要我帮托宾修锅，他就让我睡在这上头。

6DAD2918CF5C60CEDB96451B650E2B35.source: Every book on these shelves has a pressed leaf in it. She says the leaves remember the year better than the ink.
6DAD2918CF5C60CEDB96451B650E2B35.target: 这些书架上的每本书里都夹着一片压平的叶子。她说，叶子比墨水更记得住那一年。

9C1586787EA4FC6BB477ACE955F7D403.source: Take a heel of the loaf, the crusty end. It is the best part and nobody else knows it.
9C1586787EA4FC6BB477ACE955F7D403.target: 拿块面包头吧，脆皮的那端。那是最好吃的部分，别人都不知道。

9DA01DBD482AE500261547AC716903C9.source: Hm? Yes, I wrote it. Twelve verses. Kit knows them all. Kit is sick of them all.
9DA01DBD482AE500261547AC716903C9.target: 嗯？对，是我写的。一共十二段。基特全会唱。基特也全听腻了。

12E19623D9ACF1555EA180053E9231A4.source: Ember ale, brewed with the river's own water. It tastes of autumn, or so the label says. I wrote the label.
12E19623D9ACF1555EA180053E9231A4.target: 烬火麦酒，用这条河的河水酿的。喝起来有秋天的味道——标签上是这么写的。标签是我写的。

33E80A635EA4AFFC6C82CED9867115CB.source: Stew's on. It has been on since the founders came up the river, I'm told. I just keep adding to it.
33E80A635EA4AFFC6C82CED9867115CB.target: 炖菜在锅里呢。听说打从先人们沿河上来那会儿起，这锅就没离过火。我呀，只管往里添东西。

36C3EEAD5D4E4D09F1DCDB892F89627C.source: I'm going to be a woodcutter too. I've already cut down a dandelion.
36C3EEAD5D4E4D09F1DCDB892F89627C.target: 我以后也要当樵夫。我已经砍倒过一棵蒲公英了！

271BA2DDE762E9D0A4EAF02D6B21C1F3.source: You followed the bread, didn't you? Everyone follows the bread.
271BA2DDE762E9D0A4EAF02D6B21C1F3.target: 你是循着面包香来的吧？大家都是。

405E4432EA254EBDB62F0F3580E94C36.source: Shh — I am listening to the fire. It pops in threes before rain.
405E4432EA254EBDB62F0F3580E94C36.target: 嘘——我在听火的声音。要下雨之前，它会一连噼啪响三下。

848D9E04620898562C9BA8B8BB37A404.source: Welcome to the {Ember & Oak}! Rosalind keeps the door, I keep the taps. Between us we keep the gossip.
848D9E04620898562C9BA8B8BB37A404.target: 欢迎光临{烬火橡木旅店}！罗莎琳德管门，我管酒桶。至于闲话嘛，我们俩一起管。

869D606D6FBCA44E681BE406D8C6ED91.source: I have crossed six kingdoms and fought a wyvern in a hailstorm. Nothing prepared me for Nan's stew.
869D606D6FBCA44E681BE406D8C6ED91.target: 我曾走过六个王国，还在冰雹里与飞龙搏斗过。可这些经历，没有一样能让我招架得住南婆婆的炖菜。

1389F2D3F7C56FAA5A5F0A67660320B6.source: Master Ivo, cartographer. I am mapping every room in Emberfall. This corridor is eleven paces long. I have checked twice.
1389F2D3F7C56FAA5A5F0A67660320B6.target: 我是伊沃先生，制图师。我正在为烬落村的每一个房间绘制地图。这条走廊长十一步，我量过两遍。

2316A73F0FE55FC948F4BECB6FB0CAB6.source: Flour in your hair already? That is the windmill saying hello.
2316A73F0FE55FC948F4BECB6FB0CAB6.target: 头发上已经沾上面粉啦？那是风车在跟你打招呼呢。

04558C7D574906697D618FB17C13252E.source: Dad says the grove turns amber because the trees are shy. I think they're just cold.
04558C7D574906697D618FB17C13252E.target: 爸爸说，林子会变成琥珀色，是因为树害羞。我觉得它们只是冷而已。

A47F4CA11D804AF23E1C2ED0713532DF.source: The sails turn, the stones grind, the bread rises. A simple life. A dusty one.
A47F4CA11D804AF23E1C2ED0713532DF.target: 风车转，石磨碾，面包发。日子简单。就是灰大了点。

AB1E05A8D16E2C17E5649ECAE0E7C6F5.target: Luminati 2.5D 像素艺术引擎 · three.js

B7575005A0F0AD87C2BF5FDF5657F088.source: There's the kettle singing! Sit, sit. Everyone who knocks gets a cup, and you didn't even knock.
B7575005A0F0AD87C2BF5FDF5657F088.target: 听，水壶唱起来啦！坐，快坐。敲门的人都有一杯茶喝，你连门都没敲呢。

BF078E5503F897E52E0AA8E987D2EC2B.source: The cow is out in the paddock. She prefers it to company. I understand her.
BF078E5503F897E52E0AA8E987D2EC2B.target: 奶牛在外头的围场里。比起有人陪，它更喜欢待在那儿。我懂它。

C3D39A2F0B6CADBF0C6EB2190BD0F018.source: The windmill is round inside, you know. Rounder than you would think.
C3D39A2F0B6CADBF0C6EB2190BD0F018.target: 您知道吗，风车磨坊里面是圆的。比您想的还要圆。

D0DBC852C066BE1195F9730016D37AEA.source: Hilde, farmhand. Tobin pays me in eggs and advice. Mostly advice.
D0DBC852C066BE1195F9730016D37AEA.target: 希尔德，农场帮工。托宾拿鸡蛋和忠告付我工钱。多半是忠告。

DAA160EDF7821C67192C8D15A510F859.source: I came for one night. That was a fortnight ago.
DAA160EDF7821C67192C8D15A510F859.target: 我本打算只住一晚。那已是两个星期前的事了。

DBD3CF718724D9E612BA547A18D86BC4.source: The elder's apprentice, at your service. She is out on the square, teaching the cobbles patience.
DBD3CF718724D9E612BA547A18D86BC4.target: 我是长老的学徒，愿为您效劳。长老去广场了，正在教那些石子路学会耐心呢。

DD512683661A14E22D1DB83A4D6E5C7B.source: The hay smells of summer. Don't tell Rosalind, but it is better than her mattresses.
DD512683661A14E22D1DB83A4D6E5C7B.target: 干草里有夏天的味道。别告诉罗莎琳德，这可比她那儿的床垫舒服。

DF31568C30AFEB7F27FCCB800D4BB019.source: ♪ Oh the axe is sharp and the oak is tall, and the tea is hot when the chips all fall ♪
DF31568C30AFEB7F27FCCB800D4BB019.target: ♪ 斧头锋利哟橡树高，木屑落尽哟热茶好 ♪

E2EA679E88C75152909FAD12686ECBD1.source: The river talks all night under the floor. You get used to it. Then you can't sleep anywhere quiet.
E2EA679E88C75152909FAD12686ECBD1.target: 河水在地板底下整夜说个不停。慢慢就习惯了。习惯以后，到了安静的地方反倒睡不着。

F650327AA6E70224394C0391F5F54B40.source: A pilgrim, like me? The beds here are the softest between the mountains and the sea. I have tested many.
F650327AA6E70224394C0391F5F54B40.target: 您也和我一样是朝圣者吗？这里的床是群山与大海之间最软的。我试过的床可多了。
